data.title: Phase 1: the reconciler and the local subprocess executor
Bootstrap: Go module, CLI skeleton, CI, pinned contract bundle 3.0.0 with a Go reader per contract
tk client: every manifest command over tk --json, contract 1, fail closed on mismatch
.ticfac/ run-state store: checkpoint, attempt, decision, evidence with compare-and-swap against origin
Local subprocess executor: start/inspect/cancel/collect over a worktree per attempt, runner claude|codex|pi
Reconciler: one epic at concurrency one — claims, waves, gates, merge, boundary, cleanup ordering, restart from a clone
Profiles: implement-tick, review-epic, closeout-epic resolve to executor, runner, model, prompt
Gate run: a real ticks epic through ticfac run-epic with kill and restart at the three points
Close out Phase 1: retro, close ticks-tracker 4ik, flesh out Phase 2 (Herdr executor) here
